title: Guidelines for establishing an etching procedure for dislocation density measurements on multicrystalline silicon samples
author: Adamczyk, Stokkan, et al.

steps.title: Prepare silicon sample surface
steps.instruction: Take a 5 × 5 cm multicrystalline silicon slab, grind the surface with sandpaper and polish using a diamond suspension until a surface roughness of 1 µm is achieved.

steps.title: RCA‑1 cleaning
steps.instruction: Prepare the RCA‑1 mixture of 5 vol parts deionized water, 1 vol part ammonia water (29 % HNO₃) and 1 vol part H₂O₂ (30 %). Heat the mixture to 80 °C, agitate, and dip the wafer for 10 min.

steps.title: Rinse in deionized water
steps.instruction: Immediately after RCA‑1 cleaning, dip the wafer in deionized water (no time control required).

steps.title: 35 % HF etch
steps.instruction: Prepare 35 % hydrofluoric acid (HF). At room temperature, dip the wafer for 3 min while moving the sample holder slowly to provide gentle mixing (no agitation).

steps.title: Sopori etch (standard)
steps.instruction: Mix HF, acetic acid (CH₃COOH) and HNO₃ in a volume ratio of 36:15:2. At room temperature, dip the wafer for 25 s, moving the sample holder slowly to keep the solution well mixed.

substeps.instruction: For alternative experiments use Sopori times of 5 s, 10 s, 25 s, 75 s or 150 s as required.
For a diluted Sopori etch use a ratio of HF:CH₃COOH:HNO₃ = 36:20:1 and dip for 5 s.

steps.title: HF:HNO₃ etch (1:9)
steps.instruction: Prepare a mixture of HF and HNO₃ in a volume ratio of 1:9. Dip the wafer for 5 s at room temperature with the same slow‑mixing motion.

steps.title: Final rinse and ethanol flush
steps.instruction: Rinse the wafer in deionized water (no time control) and then flush with ethanol at room temperature.

steps.title: Optional repolish before next etch
steps.instruction: If a new etching session is required, repolish the wafer as described in step 1 (sandpaper + diamond suspension to 1 µm).

steps.title: Secco etching sequence
steps.instruction: Perform the following dips in order:

substeps.instruction: Dip in deionized water (room temperature, brief).
Dip in Secco solution for 60 s.

steps.title: Prepare Secco solution
steps.instruction: Mix 1 part of 0.15 M K₂Cr₂O₇ aqueous solution with 2 parts of 49 % HF (volume ratio 1:2). Use the mixture for the 60 s dip in step 9.

steps.title: PVScan and microscope imaging
steps.instruction: After each etching session, acquire a PVScan dislocation‑density map (step size 100 µm) and capture microscope images of the same area.

steps.title: Stitch and segment microscope images
steps.instruction: Manually stitch the microscope images in GIMP to create a larger composite, then divide the composite into squares matching PVScan pixels (100 µm × 100 µm). For low‑density regions use 200 µm × 200 µm squares and average four adjacent PVScan pixels to obtain a comparable pixel.

steps.title: ImageJ etch‑pit analysis
steps.instruction: For each segmented image perform the following steps in ImageJ:

substeps.instruction: Apply a threshold to obtain binary pits (white) on black background.
Run the ‘Watershed’ operation to separate overlapping pits.
Use ‘Analyze → Particles’ to count pits that meet size criteria.

steps.title: Measure etch‑pit size
steps.instruction: Using ImageJ’s measurement tools, record the diameter of each counted pit; average the diameters of at least 150 randomly selected pits for each etching condition.
